<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2013/05/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>DevGPT.AgentFactory</id>
    <version>1.1.3</version>
    <authors>Prospergenics</authors>
    <license type="expression">MIT</license>
    <licenseUrl>https://licenses.nuget.org/MIT</licenseUrl>
    <projectUrl>https://github.com/prospergenics/devgpt</projectUrl>
    <description>High-level agent factory for building autonomous AI agents in DevGPT. Provides configuration parsing, built-in tool collections (file ops, git, dotnet, npm, BigQuery, email, WordPress), and multi-agent flow orchestration. Simplifies creating production-ready AI agents.</description>
    <tags>ai-agents agent-factory orchestration tools bigquery email wordpress git automation</tags>
    <repository type="git" url="https://github.com/prospergenics/devgpt" commit="42c892b7f5fd8d9e2b2ec86aaa1751df8e1c3dd3" />
    <dependencies>
      <group targetFramework="net8.0">
        <dependency id="DevGPT.Generator" version="1.1.3" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="DevGPT.LLMs.Classes" version="1.1.3" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="DevGPT.LLMs.Client" version="1.1.3" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="DevGPT.LLMs.Helpers" version="1.1.3" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="DevGPT.LLMs.OpenAI" version="1.1.3" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="DevGPT.LLMs.SemanticKernel" version="1.1.3" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="DevGPT.Store.DocumentStore" version="1.1.3" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="DevGPT.Store.EmbeddingStore" version="1.1.3" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Google.Cloud.BigQuery.V2" version="3.11.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="MailKit" version="4.13.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
    </dependencies>
  </metadata>
</package>
